entrance: Through the door on the northern wall of the central courtyard of Dire Maul, with the Crescent Key from Dire Maul East.

1193.objective: Repair the Broken Trap on the path of Guard Slip'kik with a Frost Oil and a Thorium Widget.
1193.note: Frost Oil comes from Alchemy, the Thorium Widget from Engineering; both are also on the auction house. The trap freezes Slip'kik for the Tribute Run.

5518.objective: Bring Knot Thimblejack 8 Rugged Leather, 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 2 Rune Thread and an Ogre Tannin.
5518.note: The Ogre Tannin lies in a basket upstairs, past the first ramp. With Leatherworking or Tailoring you need half the materials. The suit fools Captain Kromcrush.

5525.objective: Bring Knot Thimblejack a Gordok Shackle Key. The ogres in the dungeon drop it.
5525.note: Knot leaves after this quest and leaves a cache with crafting materials and sometimes a recipe. Make the Ogre Suit first.

7703.objective: Kill Prince Tortheldrin in Dire Maul West and take the Gauntlet of Gordok Might from the chest behind him.
7703.note: Captain Kromcrush only talks to you in the Ogre Suit or after a Tribute Run. The reward is a choice of gloves.

5528.objective: Talk to Stomper Kreeg after a Tribute Run and take his free drinks.
5528.note: Only with the King of the Gordok buff.
